import FreeCADGui

# Create a new document
doc = app.newDocument("Unnamed")

# Create a sketch in the XY plane
sketch = doc.addObject("PartDesign::Sketcher", "Sketch")
sketch.Sketch = doc.addObject("Part::Plane", "Plane")
sketch.Support = [("Plane", "Plane")]

# Create a new document

# Create a Body first for PartDesign workflow
body = doc.addObject("PartDesign::Body", "Body")
doc.ActiveObject = body

sketch.MapMode = "Flat"

import FreeCAD as app
from FreeCAD import Base

# Create a new document with the name "Unnamed"
doc = app.newDocument("Unnamed")

# Create a Body for PartDesign workflow
body = doc.addObject("PartDesign::Body", "Body")

# Create a sketch on the XY plane using Sketcher workbench
sketch = doc.addObject("Sketcher::SketchObject", "Sketch")

# Get the XY_Plane reference
xy_plane = doc.getObject("XY_Plane")

# Set up the sketch attachment to XY_Plane using OXY (XY plane mapping)
sketch.AttachmentSupport = [(xy_plane, "Plane")]
sketch.AttachmentOffset = app.Base.Placement(Base.Vector(0, 0, 0), app.Base.Rotation())
sketch.MapMode = "OXY"

doc.recompute()

print(f"Sketch created: {sketch.Name}")

# Add a horizontal line from (0,0) to (10,0) - 10mm long using LineSegment
from Part import LineSegment
ls = LineSegment(app.Base.Vector(0, 0, 0), app.Base.Vector(10, 0, 0))
idx = sketch.addGeometry(ls)
print(f"Added geometry at index: {idx}")

# Constrain the line to be horizontal
h_constraint = sketch.addConstraint(Sketcher.Constraint('Horizontal', 0))
print(f"Added horizontal constraint at index: {h_constraint}")

# Verify constraints
print(f"Constraints: {sketch.Constraints}")
print(f"Geometry count: {sketch.GeometryCount}")
print(f"Constraint count: {sketch.ConstraintCount}")

doc.recompute()

# Save the document
doc.saveAs("/home/user/Unnamed.FCStd")
print("Saved successfully to /home/user/Unnamed.FCStd")
